plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Interior Building Architecture A.S. Degree - Architectural Design Technology Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 28, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7847/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Map states Total Units 59-61; lower bound 59 encoded = 15+15+14+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 3 ADT 320/ARCH 329 -> 3 and second elective 1-2 -> 1). Map notes this program also meets the requirement for the Certificate of Achievement in Building Information Modeling (BIM); no separate sequence is published. ARCH 325 co-requisite per map: ARCH 320 (not a sequenced plan course; documented here, not encoded). ARCH 326 co-requisite per map: ARCH 321 (not a sequenced plan course; documented here, not encoded). ADT 322 prerequisite per map: ADT 320 or experience (ADT 320 is the Semester 3 choice-slot code). Semester 4 Area L7B suggestion: ADT 498 Work Experience in ADT. Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): ADT 310 advisory ADT 300 & 302; ADT 320 advisory ADT 310; ARCH 329 advisory ARCH 321 & 326. Elective units are determined by the number needed to total 60 units for graduation; refer to Course Number for the appropriate course level. Local Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
